dimensions.name: the Stone
dimensions.why: The Stone is the reason there is a settlement here. Ground around it that nobody tends says nobody remembers.

dimensions.name: detail underfoot
dimensions.why: Empty ground is the loudest tell of a cheap game.

dimensions.name: variety
dimensions.why: The same object repeated reads as cheap however good the object is.

dimensions.name: signs of life
dimensions.why: Clutter that implies use is what separates a set from a place.

dimensions.name: skyline
dimensions.why: A flat skyline reads as flat. Height gives a place a shape from far off.

dimensions.name: arrangement
dimensions.why: Things placed with intent — around a focal point, along a line — read as designed.

dimensions.name: edges
dimensions.why: Where the built ends and the wild begins, a hard line reads as a seam.

dimensions.name: colour
dimensions.why: One accent colour, used sparingly, does more than five used evenly.

dimensions.name: river margin
dimensions.why: The riverbank drops directly into water with no reeds, lilies, or dockside edge features.

dimensions.name: heraldic height
dimensions.why: The settlement skyline is flat apart from isolated towers, lacking tall flags and scaffolding to break the roofline.

dimensions.name: fortification
dimensions.why: The town features tall towers and rich halls but lacks stone perimeter walls and gated boundaries to define its edges.

dimensions.name: industry
dimensions.why: Lanes and yards around the craft buildings remain bare dirt, missing stored timber, stone piles, and trade crates that convey economic wealth.

dimensions.name: Garrison Staging
dimensions.why: The prominent stone tower lacks martial equipment, targets, and guard posts needed to define its defensive role.

dimensions.name: Civic Assembly
dimensions.why: The broad central thoroughfares offer no public gathering stages or fenced enclosure to structure civic life.

dimensions.name: Monolith Sanctity
dimensions.why: The carved stone monolith is the focal gathering point of the town, yet it lacks votive vessels, banners, or decorative stone borders to elevate it to a proper shrine.

dimensions.name: Waterfront Edge Detail
dimensions.why: The river bank leading up to the stone bridge is stark dirt meeting bare water without reed beds or riverbank rock lining.

dimensions.name: Civic Commerce
dimensions.why: The area around the upper houses lacks active market structures or trade hubs, leaving visual voids in the residential quarter.

dimensions.name: Shrine River Flanking
dimensions.why: The circular monolith cobble plaza drops into bare turf along the riverward side, lacking structural borders or ceremonial standards.
